Itinerary

Pre-Conference

  • By Monday May 26: Students will have data assignments described.
  • By May 26: Students will be sent a data starter kit to load relevant software on their laptops and test out their equipment.
  • By May 29: Students profiles due, 11:59 p.m.

Sunday, June 1, 2025

  • 2 p.m.: Welcome at Knight Hall Eaton Theater. Wells, Herzog, Denny, Hughes and Shirley Carswell, DJNF Executive Director
    • Logistics. The week ahead. Rooms meals.
    • Student introductions.
    • Investigate your community: Wells - GitHub Slides - Link to DJNF GitHub repositories - Investigate your community memo
  • 3:30 p.m.: Use data to find stories.
    • Spreadsheet track: Herzog. Eaton Theater
    • Coding track: Wells. Room 1109
  • 4:30 p.m.: Break and then independent work
    • Students review data memos for their assigned communities. Produce draft story ideas by 11:59 p.m.
  • 5:30 p.m.: Break
  • 6:00 p.m.: Dinner in Hyattsville - (Meet at Knight Hall board van)
  • 11:59 p.m.: Produce one paragraph draft story ideas by 11:59 p.m., emailed to Wells & Herzog

      • A powerful tool to summarize data
      • Knight Hall Room 2107

    • Slides for talk

  • 2:15 p.m.: Using GitHub. All attend. (Wells/Lang) GitHub refresher

  • 2:45 p.m.: Workshop for story pitch memo due at 11:59 p.m. (Wells, Denny, Herzog, TA coach). Rooms 2103, 2107

  • 4 p.m.: Diversity is Good Journalism: Covering All of the Community. (Prof. Christoph Mergerson). All attend. Room 2103

    • Readings before talk

  • 6:30 p.m.: Dinner on campus
